# Conclusion

In this project, I performed exploratory data analysis on the Superstore Sales dataset using Python.

I used Pandas, NumPy, Matplotlib, and Seaborn for data cleaning, KPI analysis, customer segmentation, and data visualization.

The analysis helped identify:

* high-performing categories
* profitable regions
* top customers
* loss-making products
* monthly sales and profit trends
* discount impact on profitability

I performed univariate, bivariate, and multivariate analysis to better understand customer behavior and business performance.

Key findings from the project:

* Technology category generated the highest sales and strong profit.
* The West region contributed significantly to overall profitability.
* Higher discounts negatively impacted profit in many cases.
* Some products generated losses despite good sales performance.
* VIP customers contributed major revenue to the business.

This project improved my understanding of:

* data analysis workflow
* KPI calculation
* customer segmentation
* trend analysis
* business insights
* real-world retail sales analysis using Python

Overall, this project strengthened my practical skills in Data Analytics and Business Analysis and helped me understand how data can support business decision-making.
